title: “I Am Doing a Great Work”
traveler_why: Wren the Wonderer is the Traveler who pauses to ask what matters most, and tonight Nehemiah will not come down from his great work: Wren stops mid-clean-up when a friend calls, wonders what comes first, and finishes her job before she plays.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she stops to think about what matters most. In Wren’s world today: Wren was cleaning up like Mom asked when a friend called, “Come play right now!” Wren paused and wondered, “What’s most important first?” She finished her job, then went to play with a happy heart. Just like Nehemiah wouldn’t come down from his great work, Wren knew the difference between a silly distraction and an important job.
